六级大纲词汇 · 01英文原文

Two Numbers in the Storm

暴风雨里的两个数字 · 596 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1An abrupt fall in the barometer brought the maritime patrol back to the wharf. A tropical hurricane had passed, but its fury still lashed the cape. A tanker reported a collision with a survey barge in the strait. Floating debris put a second vessel in imminent jeopardy. Without clearance for an airborne search, the patrol had minutes to deploy a tug. Mara answered at the depot.

2A frantic caller gave the latitude and then went silent. No longitude. The barge had drifted from a desolate isle. A yacht had seen it collide with the tanker. Mara rigged an auxiliary antenna to ascertain the yacht's whereabouts. The amplified signal named a landmark in the cape's vicinity. On the atlas she marked where the accounts could converge. The convergence put the barge where a spill could strand other boats.

3A submarine ridge lay across that range. A tug on standby could navigate around it, but a diversion would jeopardize the rescue if the hull sank first. The lookout mistook a red light beyond the ridge for a flare. The light blinked at regular intervals. Mara asked him to check for glare from the shore. It was a beacon designed to warn vessels in adverse winds. She persuaded the captain to abort the turn and dispatch a second detachment to a narrow passage.

4Two surveyors were still afloat, huddled in a canoe and gasping. The tug retrieved them and learned that a surveyor could not evacuate the barge. In the rescue helicopter's cockpit, the pilot heard that the barge's crane had toppled across the stern. He could not hover in close proximity to it. He chose to maneuver along the sheltered flank and stay aloft until the deck came into view.

5As the helicopter approached, a rope snapped and a flap of canvas began to lash the rail. The surveyor staggered, stumbled, and caught a stout post. A rescuer descended but his line tangled around a peg. Rather than heave on it, he climbed a step and freed the tangle. The crew hoisted both men clear of the crane. On the tug, a worker used a rigid brace to shield the injured man's leg.

6One of the canoeists asked about a fuel crate left on deck. If a wave submerged the deck and broke the crate open, the fuel could unleash a fire and devastate the coastal nursery. Mara sent a salvage squad as soon as the turbulence eased. A buffer of rock on the peninsula held back the swell. A second crate had split. Its contents could ignite near the engine. The crew towed both crates into a haven before a fresh wave shattered the deck. The tide began to recede just after they reached refuge.

7The aftermath report listed one casualty and warned that an onshore blaze could have turned the loss into a greater catastrophe. The captain asked what could avert a catastrophic spill next time. Humidity had crippled a connector, and its corrosion had distorted the radio signal. A robust radio would help, but it could not identify an unrelated light. She asked the depot to allocate time to a navigation drill in which the obvious clue was wrong.

8A weary trainee ran the first simulation. She checked whether the two bearings agreed and asked the caller to repeat both numbers. This time the boat reached its target before the clock ran out. A simulated deployment tested their adherence to the rule. Mara remembered the silence after the latitude. On each new radio she taped a note. "Give both numbers before you say anything else."

六级大纲词汇 · 01中文译文

暴风雨里的两个数字

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1气压计读数骤降，海上巡逻队立即返回码头。热带飓风已经过境，余威仍在鞭打海岬。一艘油轮报告说，它在海峡里撞上了一艘测量驳船。漂浮的残骸随时可能危及另一艘船。巡逻队没有获准从空中搜寻，只剩几分钟可以派出拖船。玛拉在调度站接听了呼叫。

2呼叫者慌忙报出纬度，随后没了声音。经度还没说。驳船是从一座荒岛附近漂过来的，有艘游艇目睹了它和油轮相撞。玛拉架起备用天线，想确定游艇的位置。信号放大后，她听到了海岬附近一个地标的名字。她在地图册上标出两条线索可能交会的位置。驳船就在那里，一旦漏油，其他船也可能被困。

3那片水域横着一道海底山脊。待命的拖船可以绕过去，但如果驳船先沉下去，绕路就会耽误救援。瞭望员把山脊外一盏红灯误当成了信号弹。玛拉发现灯光按固定的间隔闪烁，便请他查看岸上是否有强光。那是一盏警示船只防范恶劣风况的航标灯。她说服船长取消转向，另派一支小队去一处狭窄的水道。

4两名测量员还在水面上，蜷缩在一只独木舟里，大口喘着气。拖船把他们救上来，得知还有一名测量员无法离开驳船。救援直升机的飞行员在驾驶舱收到消息，驳船的吊机倒在了船尾。他不能在吊机近旁悬停，于是决定从背风的一侧迂回，先留在空中，等看清甲板再靠近。

5直升机飞近时，一根绳索突然绷断，松开的帆布抽打着栏杆。测量员踉跄了几步，绊了一下，抓住一根结实的立柱。救援人员降下来，绳子却缠在一根钉子上。他没有硬拽，而是向上爬了一步，把绳结解开。机组随后把两人吊离吊机。到了拖船上，一名工作人员用硬质支具保护伤者的腿。

6独木舟上的一人想起甲板上还有一箱燃料。要是海浪淹没甲板、撞破箱子，燃料可能引发火灾，毁掉沿岸的幼鱼栖息地。湍流一缓，玛拉便派出打捞小队。半岛上的岩石挡住了部分涌浪。另一只箱子已经裂开，里面的东西靠近发动机就可能点燃。小队赶在下一股浪打碎甲板之前，把两箱燃料拖进避风港。他们刚到安全水域，潮水就开始退了。

7事后报告记录了一人受伤，并指出如果火烧到岸上，损失还会更大。船长问，下次怎样才能避免灾难性的泄漏。潮气让一个接头失灵，腐蚀又使无线电信号失真。结实可靠的新电台会有帮助，但它分辨不了碰巧出现在那里的灯光。玛拉请调度站安排一次导航演练，特意设置一条看似明显却错误的线索。

8一位疲惫的学员参加了第一次模拟。她核对两个方位是否一致，并请呼叫者把两个数字各重复一遍。这次救援船在时限内到达了目标位置。这场模拟出动检验了大家是否遵守规则。玛拉还记得纬度之后那段沉默。她在每台新电台上都贴了同一句话，先报两个数字，再说别的。
